name: Should I choose side-by-side appliances or a stacked washer and dryer?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose side-by-side appliances or a stacked washer and dryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stacked laundry units free up valuable floor space for extra cabinetry, a linen closet, or a folding bench, but side-by-side units allow for a continuous countertop surface directly above the machines. Choosing a stacked configuration is ideal for compact spaces or converted closets, though reaching top controls can be challenging for some household members. Side-by-side setups take up more horizontal space but accommodate under-counter placement, built-in shelving, and adjacent utility sinks more comfortably.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stacked units save valuable floor space, while side-by-side appliances allow for a continuous work countertop across the top.
